generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Minimum financial turnover (civil engineering construction works) not less than two times the annual payments from this contract (Rs. xxxxx Lakhs)
Satisfactoriy completed (atleast 90%) as prime contractor at-least one such similar work of value not less than Rs. xxxxxxx (80% of estimated cost of tender)

Tenderer or his identified Sub Contractor should possess valid Electrical License for executing building electrificatio works and should have executed similar electrical works totallng Rs. xxxxxx (not less than 50% of electrical works) n any one year

Tenderer or his identified Sub Contractor should possess valid license for executing water supply / sanitary engineering works  and should have executed similar works totallng Rs. xxxxxx (not less than 50% of electrical works) n any one year
Total value of civl engineering works executed and payments received in the last five years (year-wise)
List of existing commitments and ongoing works
List of works for which tenders already submitted
Banker Details for reference
Construction equipment owned by the tenderer and equipment proposed to be deployed on this contract, if awarded
Reports on the financial standing of the tenderer, such as profit and loss statements and auditor’s reports for the last five years
Qualification and experience of the key technical and management personnel in permanent employment with the tenderer and those that are proposed to be deployed on this contract, if awarded

Proposals for subcontracting components of works amounting to more than 20% of the contract price (for each, the qualifications and experience of the identified sub-contractor in the relevant fields should be attached)

In the case of death of a contractor after executing / commencement of the work, his legal heir, if an eligible registered contractor and willing can execute and complete the work at the accepted tender rates irrespective of the cost of work.
The amount put to tender is Exclusive of GST and the tenderer should quote Without GST
During the time of technical evaluation, if the employer finds that any certification/ information furnished is false, such bidders will be disqualified and barred from participation in the bid.
The intending bidders are advised to visit the site of work before submitting their tenders.
If any of the dates mentioned above happened to be a general holiday, the next working day holds good.
Any Modification/ corrections will be published in the KPP -portal. The bidders are advised to visit the KPP portal web site regularly.
FOR MORE CONDITIONS AND CRITERIAL REFER UPLOADED BID DOCUMENT

To qualify for award of this contract, each tenderer in his name should have in the last five years period. i.e.,2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24 ,2024-25 & 2026-26 Achieved in at least Two financial years an average annual financial turnover (in all Class of Civil Engineering Construction Works only) of Rs. 32.15 Lakhs. (Usually not less than the estimated annual payment under this contract) (Updated to the FY in which the tenders are invited. Financial turnover of previous years shall be given a weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the price level of the financial year in which the tenders are invited). (The Turnover certificate issued by registered chartered Accountants along with UDIN)

To qualify for award of this contract, each tenderer in his name should have in the last five years period. i.e.,2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24 ,2024-25 & 2026-26 Satisfactorily completed (at least 90% of the contract value), as prime contractor, at least one similar work Such as Construction / O & M of 7D theatre / Mirror maze/ similar Entertainment projects works of value not less than Rs. 16.07 Lakhs. (Usually not less than 50% Estimated Value of Contract)(Updated to the FY in which the tender are invited. The value of the completed works shall be given weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the price level of FY in which the tenders are invited and The necessary work done certificate issued by an officer not below the rank of Executive Engineer / Equivalent officer of the concerned division).

Tenderers who meet the above specified minimum qualifying criteria, will only be qualified, if their available tender capacity is more than the total tender value. The available tender capacity will be calculated as under:Assessed available tender capacity is equal to (AxNx2.5minusB)whereA is equal to Maximum value of civil engineering works executed in any one year during the last five years at 2025to26 price level(updated to the Financial year in which the tender is invited) taking into account the completed as well as works in progress.N is equal to Number of years prescribed for completion of the works for which Tenders are invited.B is equal to Value, at 2026to27 price level (updated to the Financial year in which the tender is invited) of existing commitments and ongoing works to be completed during the next 6 months (period of completion of the works for which Tenders are invited).Note: The statements showing the value of existing commitments and on-going works as well as the stipulated period of completion remaining for each of the works listed should be countersigned by the Employer in charge, not below the rank of an Executive Engineer or equivalent

Design, fabrication, Supply, Installation & Commissioning of  ground to supported 17Ft x 8Ft Illusion Tunnel utilizes a heavy duty steel or structural steel base frame equipped with stationary polyurethane guide wheelsorgear arrangement systems, eliminating the need for overhead suspension trusses by supporting the rotating barrel entirely from below. The 17 to foot long, 8 to foot diameter rotating cylinder features a flame to retardant, UV to reactive vinyl or polycarbonate inner liner printed with an optical vortex pattern, driven at an adjustable 4 to 12 RPM via a 0.5 to 1.0 HP AC gearmotor governed by a Variable Frequency Drive (VFD) for smooth soft to start operations. Completely decoupled from the spinning shell by a safe 2 to inch clearance gap, a stationary, independent steel bridge with a 30 to to to 36 to inch wide anti to slip diamond plate walkway and 42 to inch high handrails runs through the center. The system operates on standard 110Vor220V power, incorporates under to rail mounted blacklight or LED illumination arrays, and includes dual emergency to stop buttons at the entrance and exit curtains to ensure full compliance with amusement safety regulations. Including all necessary signal & power cables, necessary panel board with all accessories. Also includes repairs & replacement of 3 nos of mirrors at mirror maze and replacement of all damaged LED strip lights etc, Complete with all leads and lifts as directed by Engineer in charge. (buy back of existing items)

Providing and replacing premium heavy duty leatherette (polyurethaneorPU) upholstery cloth to existing 24 nos of seats of 7D theatre and safety seat belts for the 7D theatre motion chairs, ensuring complete compatibility with the existing pneumatic or hydraulic multi to axis motion bases. The scope includes stripping the worn upholstery, inspecting the internal foam structure, and supplying and installing high to tensile, automotive to grade adjustable 2 to point safety seat belts with secure quick to release buckle mechanisms capable of withstanding continuous dynamic motion forces. The replacement upholstery material must be water to resistant to withstand frequent cleaning and high visitor footfall. The work encompasses the supply of all necessary industrial adhesives, high to strength nylon stitching threads, heavy to duty fastening staples, and anchoring hardware, executed by specialized technicians to ensure seamless integration, smooth movement clearances, and strict adherence to safety standards. complete with all necessary repairs for successful operation with all lead and lift as directed by the Engineer in charge.(buy back of existing items)

Providing and laying heavy to duty, commercial to grade, self to adhesive PVC (polyvinyl chloride) or nitrile rubber flooring mats at the 7D theatre and mirror maze floors. The scope of work involves the complete removal of the existing worn flooring, thorough surface preparation including grinding, cleaning, and applying a moisture to tolerant, high to tack industrial to grade primeroradhesive to ensure a flawless bond to the granite subfloor. The replacement flooring mat must be highly durable, scratch to resistant, slip to resistant (minimum R10 rating), fire to retardant, and sound to dampening to absorb the acoustic vibrations of the 7D motion systems and prevent echo reflections within the mirror maze. The material used in the mirror maze must feature a non to reflective, matte finish to maintain the optical illusion, while the entire installation encompasses the supply of specialized edge to binding profiles, heavy to duty transition strips, seamless joint to welding rods, and all necessary floor to prep compounds, executed flawlessly to prevent tripping hazards and withstand rigorous daily maintenance and high visitor footfall. complete with all necessary repairs for successful operation with all lead and lift as directed by the Engineer in charge. (buy back of existing items)
